title: Correct period expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be T = (3π/2)√(l/g).

title: Correct planet mass
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be M = (4gR²)/G.

title: Period as composite motion
description: Important Criteria: The solution must treat the full oscillation as two half-periods from two different pendulum lengths (l and l/4).

title: Relating periods to gravity
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly relate the measured period on planet X to its surface gravity g' using the formula from part (1).

title: Applying Newton's law of gravitation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply g' = GM/R² to solve for the planet's mass M.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The final answers should have correct dimensional units for period and mass.

title: Incorrect half-period sum
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly sums the half-periods, e.g., using the full period for each segment or misidentifying the lengths.

title: Algebraic or ratio error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize sign errors, incorrect inversion of the period ratio, or algebraic mistakes when solving for g' or M.
